name: GTR
title: The general time-reversible rate matrix

citation.title: Some Probabilistic and Statistical Problems in the Analysis of DNA Sequences

journal.name: Lectures on Mathematics in the Life Sciences

args.name: sym
args.description: Relative exchangeabilities, keyed by unordered letter pair

args.name: pi
args.description: Equilibrium frequencies, keyed by alphabet symbol

description: A reversible rate matrix with a separate exchangeability for each unordered pair of letters and specified equilibrium frequencies. Off-diagonal rates are proportional to sym(i,j) * pi[j]; the matrix is scaled to have mean substitution rate 1. For codon alphabets, the rate is measured per nucleotide site. Pair keys concatenate the letters, such as AC or CA; supply one entry per pair.
